description: This file is a shell script designed for testing CVS repository import processes, specifically testing patchset estimation and handling of revisions with identical commit times. It includes setup routines, test expectations, and command invocations for CVS and Git operations.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up the CVS test repository with the specified name.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to fail, with parameters specifying environment, name, and commands.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected output with actual output files.
